verdict.rationale: Granola documents a built-in CSV export, an open format, from Settings. It covers note titles, summaries, transcripts and basic details, and is explicitly positioned for backups, migration and GDPR data portability. A REST API also exposes notes, transcripts and folders, but only on Business/Enterprise plans. Missing for 10: evidence that the export covers ALL data (e.g. captured screen snapshots, folders/spaces structure, templates, recipes, chat history), richer open formats such as Markdown or JSON bulk export on all plans, documented account deletion to complete 'leaving', and independent hands-on corroboration of a full migration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export your Granola meeting notes to CSV. Get note titles, summaries, transcripts, and details. Useful for backups, migration, or GDPR data portability requests.
The CSV includes the title, note summary, transcript, and other basic details for each note.
You're able to export historical data from Granola by going to Settings, clicking Profile in the sidebar (under Preferences), and clicking Generate CSV
The Granola API lets you build custom integrations with programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries.
